details: Nine MySQL mysql_atomic integration tests passed, including failed-batch rollback, MyISAM/MEMORY/CSV/ARCHIVE effects, INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE trigger effects, AUTO_INCREMENT, and a trigger session-variable side effect.

The PostgreSQL backend-termination rollback_failure selector passed; the driver reported TransactionRollbackFailed, table writes rolled back, and identity/trigger sequence allocations remained advanced.

mssql-kerberos.boundary: Samba AD fixture results do not establish Windows AD interoperability.

latest_tip_followup.result: The b4-rollback layer passed on the newer linux tip after PR #308 changed PostgreSQL integration tests. Nine MySQL atomicity tests and the PostgreSQL backend-termination rollback-failure selector passed.

MySQL behavior for engines and side effects outside the explicit tested contract.
